*First look at your fleet: two things to fix first*

1 cluster scanned in full · 9 configuration checks

- `critical` invoice-worker mounts a static project-editor service account key from the Secret invoice-gcp-key · Anyone who reads the Secret holds editor on the project. Move it to Workload Identity.
- `critical` log-shipper DaemonSet has 0 of 4 pods running: every pod is in ImagePullBackOff on a tag that no longer exists · No node ships its logs. Point log-shipper at a published tag.

5 more items are queued, 2 of them critical. I'll bring up to 2 critical a day.

*What the scan checked*
startup probes
ResourceQuota and LimitRange
read-only root filesystems
Shielded Nodes
Dataplane V2
Managed Service for Prometheus
node auto-upgrade
static Google Cloud keys in pods
added capabilities
